title: Early Versus Interval Appendectomy for Ruptured Appendicitis in Children
brief_summary: The purpose of this randomized trial is to compare two commonly utilized surgical treatments for children with ruptured appendicitis: early appendectomy, versus interval appendectomy. The primary outcome measure is time away from normal activities.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of ruptured appendicitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to have usual follow up care (e.g. transient to area)
